purpose: Predeclare the finite automatic-rule family before trace scoring.

baseline.threshold_source: complete --base-report search.best; archived current report has tau_agree=0.8839523792266846 and tau_box=0.9605637192726135, accepted=1859
baseline.expected_accepted: must match the selected base report; never hardcoded for future model runs
baseline.rule_order: For each candidate in source order and rect in rect_index order: S/R, S/B, R/B at baseline tau_agree. After all rects for that candidate, B solo at tau_box.

finite_family.event_order: Within each rect, baseline S/R then S/B then R/B pairs; if enabled, legacy S/R agreement; if enabled, solo S then solo R. After all rects in a candidate, baseline B solo.
finite_family.selection_objective: Among only these eight policies that have at least one automatic pass in each split and >=99.5% auto-pass exact-plate precision in each split, maximize total accepted over val+devhard.
finite_family.tie_break: Prefer 000; then fewer enabled switches; then lexical policy_id.

safe_augment_family.order: First run the complete baseline decision and return its result unchanged when it auto-passes. Only when baseline has no OK, scan candidates and rects in order for enabled legacy SR agreement, then enabled solo segment, then enabled solo reader. This never lets a later legacy rule steal an existing baseline pass.
safe_augment_family.safe-000: Duplicate of baseline 000; included to make the augmented family explicit.
safe_augment_family.selection_scope: Together with the eight integrated combinations, exactly sixteen preregistered policy IDs; max accepted subject to >=99.5% precision in each fixed split.

truth_independence: Rule decisions inspect only route validity, text, confidence, and declared order. Truth is used only after selection to score accepted/correct/whole-plate metrics.
fallback: Not varied or used to select an automatic policy; fixed agreement_then_reader is used only to report whole-plate accuracy when automatic policy does not pass.
outcome_reporting: Report both split totals, per-split whole-plate accuracy, auto precision, accepted/correct counts, route/subset/category/dark/tilt groups, and fit/hold descriptive groups. No threshold sweep beyond the sixteen declared combinations.
